```sql
SELECT l.location_id, l.location_name, SUM(o.order_total) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0) AS average_order_value
FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."orders" o
JOIN "jaffle_shop"."dev"."locations" l ON o.location_id = l.location_id
GROUP BY l.location_id, l.location_name
ORDER BY average_order_value DESC
```
